tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Check connection status only when the user explicitly asks whether Easy-Peasy.AI is connected. Returns only a boolean. Do not call for general knowledge, account deletion, or requests for credentials or personal details; those requests are unsupported by this tool.

tools.name: list_templates
tools.description: List a page of Easy-Peasy.AI writing templates (presets), optionally filtered by category. Returns slug, title, description, and category, plus total, categories, and next_offset (null on the last page). Use get_template to inspect a known slug directly, then generate_text to run it.

tools.name: get_template
tools.description: Get one text generation template by slug, including its input fields (name, label, type, options). Field names like "keywords" and "extra1".."extra14" map directly onto generate_text parameters.

tools.name: generate_text
tools.description: Generate text with an Easy-Peasy.AI template (preset). Synchronous — returns the generated text. Uses the account word quota and requires available API token allowance. tools.name: generate_image
tools.description: Generate or edit an image with Easy-Peasy.AI. Synchronous — returns image URL(s) when generation finishes (can take up to a few minutes). Uses image credits and requires a paid plan for API access. To edit existing images, pass their URLs in source_images; model then picks the edit model. display_me

tools.name: get_image
tools.description: Get a previously generated image by its numeric id (returned by generate_image).

tools.name: generate_video
tools.description: Start an AI video generation. Defaults to MiniMax H3 Max: 5 seconds, 768p, native audio, 4 credits per second at 768p. With an image and no model, uses MiniMax H3 Max Image. tools.name: get_video
tools.description: Check a video generation started with generate_video. Returns { video: { id, url, status } } — status is "processing" until the video is ready, then "completed" with the download url.

tools.name: display_media
tools.description: Show Easy-Peasy.AI images in an embedded gallery or videos in an embedded player. Use IDs returned by generate_image, get_image, generate_video, or get_video. tools.name: list_voices
tools.description: List a page of text-to-speech voices (id, name, language, accent), including the account’s custom/cloned voices. Filter by language and optionally accent. tools.name: generate_speech
tools.description: Convert text to speech (ElevenLabs-powered). Synchronous — returns the audio file URL. Billed against the account’s monthly text-to-speech character quota.
